_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: "The suggestion" is [data-testid="next-prompt-suggestion"]; "the input" is the message input [data-testid="message-input"]. "The button" is the suggestion's button [data-testid="next-prompt-suggestion-use"]. The window.* helpers return "ok" or what is wrong; check each with an eval step expecting "ok". On a short phone screen, a suggestion too long for the input is cut off like overflowing text, no taller than the input gets (40% of the 240px screen), and its button stays in sight at the bottom. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/basil. 2. The suggestion should come to contain "{{EXPECTED}}". 3. Eval window.suggestionInside(), window.inputNoTallerThan(97), window.suggestionCutOff(), window.useOnLastLine() and window.markInput(). 4. Tap the button: a touch step "start" on it, immediately followed by a touch step "end". 5. The input's value should become exactly "{{EXPECTED}}". 6. Eval window.inputSettled(0.5).
